title: Tactical Breach Wizards
editionScope: Base Steam campaign; Special Edition extras are excluded from matching.

notes.text: Distinctive wizard abilities and upgrade perks offer a concrete basis for exploring ability synergies.

tradeoffs.text: The developer describes an authored story rather than a branching plot or base-building campaign. Compact is a provisional format label, not a stopping-time guarantee.

evidence.statement: The developer presents a wizard team uncovering a modern conspiracy in a story-led campaign.
evidence.locator: About This Game opening; Get to Know These Loveable Idiots

evidence.statement: The description advertises spell combinations, character-specific abilities, perk upgrades, knockback and rewinds.

evidence.statement: We classify its handcrafted encounters and described shorter story campaign as a compact mission format.
evidence.locator: About This Game opening; What Is It Not?
limitations: Format classification is provisional; no session length or working demo access is established.

tradeoffs.text: Headquarters and research management extend the experience beyond encounter tactics; DLC-specific changes are not included here.

evidence.statement: The base-game description names soldier classes, skill trees, headquarters rooms, research and equipment upgrades.
evidence.locator: Recruit Resistance Fighters; Research, Develop and Upgrade

evidence.statement: Concealment, ambushes and extraction objectives suggest a positioning-oriented tactical profile.

title: Into the Breach

notes.text: Telegraphed attacks and civilian protection offer a specific planning emphasis; that does not mean every system is nonrandom.

tradeoffs.text: Each attempt has a generated challenge. Compact is a format interpretation, not a measured guarantee of short sessions.

evidence.statement: The developer describes future mech squads confronting aliens through newly generated attempts.
evidence.locator: About This Game; Advanced Edition; introductory description
limitations: Generated challenges preclude interpreting telegraphed attacks as no randomness anywhere.

evidence.statement: We infer a compact, positioning-focused format from the described minimal combat, telegraphed attacks and building protection.
evidence.locator: Key Features: Defend the Cities; Perfect Your Strategy
limitations: No battle/session timing or direct positioning comparison was measured.

evidence.statement: The developer describes finding weapons and pilots while moving between islands.
evidence.locator: Key Features: Build the Ultimate Mech
limitations: Does not establish character-build depth or balance.
